'''Ira Mayers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 31 October 1999 with Tatooine/CC Mains & Toys, according to Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d95">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ boca-raton-florida-10-31-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 5 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
